behavior: Plan a fresh run (or continue --run <id>) and drive it plan->dispatch->fulfill->accept->commit via the agent backend; returns a DriveResult JSON.
Advance exactly one deterministic drive step, then stop with status in-progress/parked/blocked/complete.
Key EVERY task into the content-addressed result cache (schemaVersion 2: prompt + run.inputs + delegation digest + upstream result digests); re-run reuses the unchanged prefix.
Round width >1 selects the concurrent batch driver with deterministic recording order; forwarded from the CLI into drive().
Continue an existing run instead of planning a new one (run --drive path).
Inject the drive clock; all retry/park timestamps derive from it (determinism).
Read-only deterministic preview of the next drive step (DrivePreview); no mutation, no spawn. MCP: cw_run_drive.
Read-only resume payload by default; with --drive/--once hands the SAME run to the drive core and adds a drive field. MCP: cw_run_resume.
MCP twin of run --drive; same drive() core, mutating, payloadIdentical false.
MCP twin of the read-only drive preview; byte-identical payload to the CLI JSON.
MCP twin of run resume; requiredArgs [runId].
Verifier-gated commit unless --allow-unverified-checkpoint; bare CLI commit fails closed.
0 forces drive progress lines off, 1 forces on; default: on only when stderr is a TTY. All progress on stderr with prefix [drive].
When matching /^(1|true|yes|on)$/i, dispatch ids become dispatch-<seq> (no wall clock) and run ids drop the stamp.
Agent command template (argv, {{input}}/{{result}}/{{model}} tokens; builtin:<name> expands from builtin-templates.json). Part of agent-configured check.
HTTP agent endpooint alternative to a command; either one makes the drive agent-configured.
Operator model policy interpolated into {{model}}; NEVER the attested model (that comes only from the agent report, else "unreported").
Per-hop agent timeout forwarded as delegation timeoutMs.
Opt-in fail-closed telemetry: an accept without attested usage parks the hop.
Opt-in strict commit gate: file-style verifier evidence must resolve on disk (commit-verifier-evidence-unresolvable).

When every task is completed, commit once with reason "agent-delegation-drive: audited verdict committed" (verifier = verdict/synthesis task's verifierNodeId, else allowUnverifiedCheckpoint); later drives return action complete.

Unconfigured agent blocks with the exact reason string "agent backend not configured (set CW_AGENT_COMMAND/CW_AGENT_ENDPOINT or pass --agent-command/--agent-endpoint) — refusing rather than fabricating a completion".
No eligible worker with incomplete tasks blocks with reason "no eligible worker (a parked/failed worker blocks the phase gate)".

limits.tokenBudget enforced against recorded usage before each spawn: blocked with "token budget exhausted: <spent> recorded tokens >= budget <n> — refusing to spawn further agents"; never re-checked between accepts of one round.

A failed hop charges one attempt (max of in-memory and persisted retryCount); at maxAttempts (default 3) the worker parks terminally via recordWorkerFailure code agent-delegation-parked, task becomes failed, phase gate stops.
A retryable failed hop leaves the task running and reuses the SAME worker scope on the next step (no re-dispatch); attempts + last reason persisted on the scope.

maxIterations = (plannedWorkers + maxLoopExpansion) * (maxAttempts+1) + 5; exhaustion appends a blocked step with reason "drive reached max iteration limit (<n>) before a terminal state" and status blocked, never complete.

--once: complete iff all workers done AND agent-delegation-drive commit exists, else last parked/blocked, else in-progress; full drive: blocked on exhaustion, parked when any task failed, blocked when last step blocked, else complete.
Step selection: the first runnable phase's running task first, else its next pending task; deterministic order.
A phase with mode "parallel" auto-sizes the concurrent round to min(limits.maxConcurrentAgents, phase task count) with no flag; explicit --concurrency overrides.
Concurrent children run in parallel but results settle and record in deterministic batch (task-id) order; collect-all: one failed/hung hop never aborts siblings.

A concurrent round defers per-task persistence and flushes state exactly once at round end (commitState reason "concurrent-round:<n>-tasks" + report + checkpoint); crash mid-round loses only the round's bookkeeping.
Batch child env = sandbox-filtered env plus every process env key matching /^(CW_|ANTHROPIC_|OPENAI_|GEMINI_|DEEPSEEK_|CODEX_|GOOGLE_|COHERE_|MISTRAL_|OLLAMA_|AZURE_|AWS_)/i.

A result-cache hit copies the cached bytes into result.md and still goes through recordWorkerOutput validation; step is accept/ok with handleKind result-cache and reason "result cache hit"; a rejected cached result fails the hop ("result cache rejected: <msg>").

Default cache only for tasks with resultCache {mode:"read-write", keyInput}; key = sha256({schemaVersion:1, workflowId, taskId, keyInput, keyValue, promptDigest, completedResultsDigest}); includeCompletedResults "previous-phases" folds earlier-phase result bytes.

--incremental key = sha256(stableStringify({schemaVersion:2, workflowId, taskId, promptDigest, runInputsDigest, delegationDigest, upstreamResultsDigest})); delegation digest folds model/agentType/sandboxProfileId/command/secret-stripped args/endpoint; undefined upstream digest disables caching.
Content-addressed result cache file; written atomically via <file>.<pid>.tmp + rename.
MAX_SUB_WORKFLOW_DEPTH = 4; exceeding fails the hop with "sub-workflow depth limit exceeded (> 4)" BEFORE any child state is minted (then normal retry/park).
A child appId already on [visitedAppIds..., parentApp] fails the hop with "sub-workflow cycle detected: <path>"; catches direct self-cycles at depth 0.
Child run id is sub-<parent-run-id>-<safe-task-id>, injected into plan(); child inputs = repo/cwd/question defaults plus {{name}} templates rendered from PARENT inputs.

Child report.md (default) or verdict result (bindResult "verdict-result") is written as the parent worker's result.md and accepted through the SAME recordWorkerOutput gate; incomplete child or missing bytes fail the hop.

After accept, one worker.sub-workflow audit event pins {subWorkflowAppId, subRunId, childReportDigest, childAuditVerified, bindResult} and task.subRunId/subRunDir are set; a cross-link failure never undoes the accept.

maybeExpandLoop runs after each accepted worker result and expands at most ONE loop boundary: when the latest round completes, evaluate until (predicate or budget-target), record a loop-control node, then append round n+1 (cloned template tasks id <base>@r<n+1>, phase <origin>@r<n+1>) or set loopDone.
done = predicate.done || round >= maxRounds; the loop can never exceed maxRounds (fail-closed).
An unregistered predicate ref stops the loop with reason 'loop predicate "<ref>" not registered — stopping fail-closed' (recorded, no throw).
until {kind:"budget-target", target} stops when recorded totalTokens >= target with reason "budget-target: <spent>/<target> recorded tokens"; limits.tokenBudget stays the absolute backstop.
Registry ships "no-new-findings" (stop when a round has no findings) and "single-round" (always stop); registerLoopPredicate overwrites by name.
maxLoopExpansion(run) = sum over loop phases of (maxRounds-1)*template task count, folded into the drive iteration bound; pure function of the declaration.
Id <run-id>:loop-control:<origin-phase-id>:r<round>, kind loop-control, status completed, outputs {round, done, atCap, reason} — the replay source of truth for loop decisions.

{schemaVersion:1, runId, action, status, taskId?, workerId?, phase?, backendId?, attempts?, handleKind?, reportedModel?, reason?}; actions dispatch|fulfill|accept|commit|park|blocked|complete; statuses ok|parked|blocked|failed|complete.
{schemaVersion:1, runId, workflowId, status complete|parked|blocked|in-progress, steps[], plannedWorkers, completedWorkers, parkedWorkers, commitId?, reportPath, statePath, agentConfigured}.

{schemaVersion:1, runId, workflowId, plannedWorkers, pendingWorkers, completedWorkers, parkedWorkers, nextAction, nextTaskId?, nextPhase?, agentConfigured}; nextAction commit|blocked|dispatch|fulfill.

[drive]-prefixed stderr lines: per-step "<n>. <action> <status> <taskId> model=<m> — <reason>", spawn/cache/sub-workflow glyph lines (→ ↺ ⧉ ⇉), and phase boundaries "==> <Title> ✓|⇉|… (done/total)"; stdout stays clean data.

Default contract cw.pipeline.default: 6 stages (plan, dispatch, result, verify, commit, report) with the exact accept kinds/statuses/artifacts/evidence in the spec; failurePolicy preserveFailureNodes true, retryableByDefault false; commitPolicy requiresVerifierGate true.
Default output status per stage: commit-producing stages default to committed (node minted verified then transitioned), all others completed; options.outputStatus overrides.

findRunnablePipelineStages filters node×stage by kind, status, required artifacts (id OR kind match, path must exist at run time via contract assert), required evidence (id OR source), and the verifier gate.
advancePipeline: idle when nothing runnable; stops at the first advanced stage; a failure stops the walk unless failurePolicy.autoAdvance is true (then it keeps trying and reports failed at the end).

Only PipelineContractError becomes a structured stage failure (failPipelineStage); any other throw propagates raw. Failure node kept only when preserveFailureNode resolves true (option > stage > contract > false); kept failures also write one feedback record.
Unknown contract id: "Unknown pipeline contract for run <id>: <cid>"; unknown node: "Unknown state node for run <id>: <nid>"; unknown stage: "Unknown pipeline stage for contract <cid>: <sid>".

Legal transitions fixed: pending->[running,blocked,failed,completed,verified,rejected]; running->[completed,failed,blocked]; completed->[verified,rejected,failed]; failed->[pending,blocked]; blocked->[pending,failed]; verified->[committed,rejected]; rejected->[pending,failed]; committed->[]; same-status always legal; committed only from verified.
nextDispatchTasks cap = Number(limit || limits.maxConcurrentAgents || 4) over the first runnable phase's pending tasks.
No dispatchable task returns {schemaVersion:1, runId, dispatchId:null, tasks:[], manifestPath:null, sandboxProfileId, backendId, backendSelection} and writes nothing.

Dispatch marks selected tasks running/act with dispatchId+dispatchedAt, allocates worker scopes, appends the dispatch node (<run-id>:dispatch:<id>, kind dispatch, status running), moves task nodes pending->running, pushes run.dispatches, refreshes phase statuses, writes the manifest JSON.
Phase order gate: a phase with running tasks, else pending tasks, is runnable; an earlier phase not fully completed with nothing pending/running returns null (blocks the run).
A file-loaded custom sandbox profile definition persists on run.customSandboxProfiles by logical id; a different definition under the same id throws 'Sandbox profile id collision: "<id>" ...'.
Verbatim: "Spawn one worker per task when the user explicitly authorized agent/parallel/background work. Save each final summary as Markdown and record it with `cw result <run-id> <task-id> <file>`."
DispatchManifest JSON (schemaVersion 1) with tasks[], workerResultPath = <workerDir>/result.md per task.
Every StateNode is (re)written on appendRunNode; id is sanitized via safeFileName.
Commit snapshot {commit, run}; commit id = 4-digit position in run.commits (deterministic).
One JSON per ErrorFeedbackRecord plus the whole-array index; both rewritten on each record/update.
Task file from renderTask (exact template with Output Contract + cw:result fence example); correction tasks land at tasks/feedback:<id>.md.

Gated when verifierNodeId/candidateId/selectionId/verifierGated set OR reason is result:<task-id> with a task verifierNodeId; gated commits record {verifierGated:true, checkpoint:false} + a commit.gate audit event + node <run-id>:commit:<id> (status committed); checkpoints record {verifierGated:false, checkpoint:true} + node <run-id>:checkpoint:<id> (kind commit, status completed).

A blocked gated commit throws CommitGateError AFTER writing an error node <run-id>:commit-gate-failed:<0001> (metadata.failures = all gate errors) linked under selection/verifier nodes, plus one feedback record (source cli|verifier, stageId commit, retryable false).
A verifier node backed by an empty-capture result can never back a gated commit: error commit-rationale-empty-capture, message 'Verifier node <id> cannot back a commit: <warning>'.

For evidence-requiring tasks (and candidate/selection commits) at least one locator must be grounded (path-like/URL/namespace:value) else commit-verifier-evidence-ungrounded; optional-evidence tasks keep the length-only check.

Candidate promotion needs: candidate not rejected/failed, scored, verified, a verified selection with a state node (kind candidate, status verified) and a scoreId; verifier linkage mismatch raises commit-verifier-linkage-mismatch keeping the requested verifier.
gitHead = `git rev-parse HEAD` with timeout 5000 ms; any failure (no repo, lock, hang) yields undefined and never blocks the commit.
commitState throws on a blocked gate; the CLI maps the uncaught throw to a non-zero exit after the error node + feedback are on disk.

Fence /```cw:result\s*([\s\S]*?)```/; invalid JSON throws 'Invalid cw:result JSON: <msg>'; no fence yields {summary: first non-heading non-fence line, findings: [], evidence: harvested grounded locators}.

Non-empty canonical findings/evidence pass through unchanged; else findings from the first non-empty of candidate_risks/candidateRisks/risks/ranked_risks/rankedRisks/top_risks/topRisks/issues/problems/concerns and evidence harvested from JSON+findings+prose (dedupe, sort, cap 256 top-level / 32 per finding).
Finding id fallback finding-<n>; classification coerced to real|conditional|non-issue|unknown; severity P0..P3 tag wins else CRIT/BLOCKER->P0, HIGH/SEV->P1, MED->P2, LOW/MINOR/NIT->P3, else none.

isEmptyCapture true when findings AND evidence are both empty; intake adds metadata.captureWarning "no findings or evidence captured from result.md" + a worker.capture-warning audit event (accepted, never silently passed).

recordFeedback dedups against unresolved records matching {code,message,nodeId,stageId,contractId,path}; new ids are feedback-<classification>-<0001> by append position; collectRunErrors dedups by the unit-separator key.

Fixed classification precedence: missing-artifact, missing-evidence, verifier-failure, state-transition, contract-violation, sandbox-policy, parse-error, pipeline-failure, runtime-error, unknown; severity map high/medium/low as specified.
createCorrectionTask is idempotent, writes tasks/feedback:<id>.md (fixed template), appends node <run-id>:task:feedback:<id> (kind task, pending, loopStage adjust), marks the record tasked.
resolveFeedback status resolved requires an existing node with status verified or committed (three exact error messages); otherwise the record is marked rejected.
Error->code map: /Invalid cw:result JSON/->result-parse-error; /requires (cw:result )?evidence/->missing-required-evidence; /Phase gate blocked/->phase-gate-blocked; else runtime-error.

The backend evidence triple (command+exitCode+sha256(stdout)) never reads result.md; result.md acceptance is the SEPARATE recordWorkerOutput layer (validate -> attest -> accept -> ledger -> verify -> completion -> fan-out, fixed order) which also triggers maybeExpandLoop.

plan() appends the input node (<run-id>:input, kind input, completed, artifact state) then one plan pipeline stage per task producing <run-id>:task:<task-id> pending nodes; ends with commitState("initial-plan").

recordResult copies the file to results/<task-id>.md, appends <run-id>:result:<task-id> (kind result, completed, evidence source cw:result per locator) and immediately runs the verify stage producing <run-id>:verifier:<task-id> with outputStatus verified; then commitState("result:<task-id>").
quickstart --resume without --run forces once:true and prints a continue line; with --run <id> continues to completion and stamps resumedFrom:<id> in the payload.

Planning a fresh run for --drive strips the runtime keys (once,now,preview,step,drive,json,format,run,runId,cwd,agent*,resume,incremental,concurrency,link,ref,branch,refresh) so agent/drive flags never enter run.inputs or the cache digests.

DEFAULT_SCHEDULING_POLICY: maxConcurrent 1, maxAttempts 3, leaseTtlMs 300000, backoffBaseMs 1000, backoffFactor 2, backoffCapMs 60000; retryOrPark parks at attempts>=maxAttempts with parkedReason '<reason> (attempt <n>/<max>)'.
dispatch-<ISO-stamp-stripped>-<4-digit-seq>, or dispatch-<seq> under CW_DETERMINISTIC_RUN_IDS.
drivePreview reads state only; counts (planned/pending/completed/parked) come from task statuses; no spawn, no write.
